biotools.summary: BOEngineeringBenchmark is a framework for evaluating Bayesian Optimization (BO) algorithms in engineering design. It introduces a constraint-handling framework using Prior-data Fitted Networks (PFNs) and provides comprehensive benchmarking across various test problems, demonstrating improved speed and solution quality.
